decision: Vehicle centerline is 25.996142 N, -97.154559 W, 18 m east of OSM way 968227813.
why: The ticket seed 25.997 N, 97.157 W is the tank farm. The catch has to land on the orbital mount, checked against the integration tower and the flame trench.

decision: Catch point is the mount centerline, not the tower mast. The tower mesh is offset west and that offset scales with model scale.
why: A mast 18 m west would fail the 5 m horizontal catch test. Scaling the offset keeps the chopsticks aimed at the booster at 1×, 10×, and 30×.

decision: Round marks T+2:40 staging near 69 km, T+7:00 catch, T+8:30 ship cutoff. Downrange is compressed on a 97° azimuth.
why: These are public Flight 5 callouts, not a telemetry fit. The real ship went to the Indian Ocean; the demo keeps the arc over the Gulf.

decision: Default model scale is 10×. Ship meshes get an along-nose lead of (scale−1)×booster height. Tower Y scale puts the arm pivot on the scaled catch pins.
why: True size disappears at coastline zoom. Uniform scale would bury the ship in the booster and leave the arms above the pins.

decision: Custom layer uses mainMatrix × translate(mercator) × scale(s,−s,s) × rotateX(π/2). Scene axes are east, up, south.
why: That is the MapLibre three.js custom-layer recipe, so the mesh stays glued to the same ground track as the camera.

decision: Bundled style, no glyphs, notice text fixed. Triggers: ?offline=1, style not idle in 8s, or style failure before first idle.
why: The demo has to keep the flight and the controls when OpenFreeMap is blocked, without a blank canvas.
